I’ll inspect span serialization and copy behavior, then add the fix and focused tests. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill for this change.
The immutable span wraps OpenTelemetry objects that contain locks. Lazy spans also try to load themselves when Python probes copy-related methods. I’ll serialize span data and attachments, rebuild immutable spans on restore, and keep restored lazy spans unloaded with only one copy of their raw data.
The new tests now pass for standalone spans and whole traces, including attachments, links, lazy restoration, and shallow-copy behavior. The span test file is still running to check for regressions.
Implemented copy and pickle support for immutable, lazy, and no-op spans, including whole traces and attachments. Lazy spans restore unloaded without duplicate raw JSON. Shallow copies preserve shared underlying spans; live spans reject deep copy and pickle with conversion guidance.

Added regression tests. All 96 span tests passed, but pytest exited with a sandbox permission error in its post-test process cleanup. No dependencies installed.

+from tests.tracing.helper import create_test_trace_info
+
+
+def pickle_round_trip(value):
+    return pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(value))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle_round_trip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("span_kind", ["immutable", "lazy", "materialized_lazy"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("whole_trace", [False, True])
+def test_span_copy_and_pickle(restore, span_kind, whole_trace):
+    attachment = Attachment(content_type="text/plain", content_bytes=b"test attachment")
+    with _get_tracer("test").start_as_current_span("parent") as otel_span:
+        live = LiveSpan(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345", span_type=SpanType.LLM)
+        live.set_inputs({"attachment": attachment, "nested": [1, 2]})
+        live.set_outputs({"result": 3})
+        live.set_status("OK")
+        live.add_event(SpanEvent("event", timestamp=123, attributes={"key": "value"}))
+        live.add_link(Link(trace_id="tr-abc123", span_id="aabbccddeeff0011"))
+    span = live.to_immutable_span()
+    expected = span.to_dict()
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        span = LazySpan(expected, raw_json=json.dumps(expected))
+        if span_kind == "materialized_lazy":
+            assert span.name == "parent"
+        span._attachments = {attachment.id: attachment}
+
+    original = (
+        Trace(info=create_test_trace_info("tr-12345"), data=TraceData([span]))
+        if whole_trace
+        else span
+    )
+    restored = restore(original)
+    assert restored is not original
+    if whole_trace:
+        assert restored.info == original.info
+        restored = restored.data.spans[0]
+    assert type(restored) is type(span)
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        assert restored.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+        assert restored.__dict__["_raw_json"] is None
+        assert span.__dict__["_materialized"] is (span_kind == "materialized_lazy")
+        assert span.__dict__["_raw_json"] is not None
+        assert set(span.__getstate__()) == {"span_data", "attachments"}
+    assert restored.to_dict() == expected
+    assert restored.name == "parent"
+    assert restored.inputs == span.inputs
+    assert restored.outputs == span.outputs
+    assert restored.events == span.events
+    assert restored.links == span.links
+    assert restored.status == span.status
+    restored_attachment = restored._attachments[attachment.id]
+    assert restored_attachment is not attachment
+    assert restored_attachment.id == attachment.id
+    assert restored_attachment.content_type == attachment.content_type
+    assert restored_attachment.content_bytes == attachment.content_bytes
+    restored.inputs["nested"].append(3)
+    assert span.inputs["nested"] == [1, 2]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle_round_trip])
+def test_live_span_copy_and_pickle_rejected(restore):
+    with _get_tracer("test").start_as_current_span("live") as otel_span:
+        span = LiveSpan(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345")
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"immutable span with to_immutable_span\(\)"):
+            restore(span)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("immutable", [False, True])
+def test_span_shallow_copy(immutable):
+    with _get_tracer("test").start_as_current_span("span") as otel_span:
+        span = LiveSpan(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345")
+        if immutable:
+            span = span.to_immutable_span()
+        copied = copy.copy(span)
+        assert copied is not span
+        assert type(copied) is type(span)
+        assert copied._span is span._span
+        assert copied._attributes is span._attributes
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, pickle_round_trip])
+def test_noop_span_copy_and_pickle(restore):
+    span = NoOpSpan()
+    restored = restore(span)
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert isinstance(restored, NoOpSpan)
+    assert restored.trace_id == span.trace_id
+    assert restored.name is None
+    restored.set_inputs({"ignored": True})
+    assert restored.inputs is None
+

+def _sse(event):
+    return [b"data: " + json.dumps(event).encode() + b"\n", b"\n"]
+
+
+def _tool_use_stream(blocks):
+    """blocks: list of ("text", str) or ("tool", id, name, partial_json)."""
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "id": "test-id",
+                "model": "claude-2.1",
+                "usage": {"input_tokens": 25, "output_tokens": 1},
+            },
+        }
+    ]
+    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
+        if block[0] == "text":
+            start = {"type": "text", "text": ""}
+            delta = {"type": "text_delta", "text": block[1]}
+        else:
+            start = {"type": "tool_use", "id": block[1], "name": block[2], "input": {}}
+            delta = {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": block[3]}
+        events += [
+            {"type": "content_block_start", "index": i, "content_block": start},
+            {"type": "content_block_delta", "index": i, "delta": delta},
+            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": i},
+        ]
+    events.append({
+        "type": "message_delta",
+        "delta": {"stop_reason": "tool_use", "stop_sequence": None},
+        "usage": {"output_tokens": 15},
+    })
+    return [line for e in events for line in _sse(e)]
+

+def _merge_tool_calls(chunks):

+    for chunk in chunks:
+        assert [c.index for c in chunk.choices] == [0]

+            call = calls.setdefault(tc.index, {"name": None, "arguments": ""})
+            call["name"] = call["name"] or tc.function.name

+    return calls
